home.hero.title: Travel easily across Morocco
home.hero.description: Discover a calmer way to move between Morocco's major destinations with polished booking, dependable departures, and a station experience built around comfort.
home.hero.visual_alt: Luxury coaches lined up for departure
home.hero.visual_copy: Contemporary vehicles, efficient boarding, and a quieter atmosphere for every trip.
home.featured.title: Choose a route designed around comfort and timing
home.featured.copy: Our highlighted departures combine reliable schedules, modern fleets, and cleaner boarding for travelers who want more than a basic transfer.
home.experience.title: A more polished transport experience from the first click to arrival
home.experience.copy: Every part of the journey is shaped to feel premium: lighter planning, calmer boarding, and support that stays present across the route.
home.experience.comfort.title: Elevated comfort
home.experience.comfort.copy: Modern coaches, cleaner waiting areas, and a calmer boarding rhythm create a smoother trip from start to finish.
home.experience.reliability.title: Dependable timing
home.experience.reliability.copy: Clear route information and well-managed departures help travelers move with more confidence across Morocco.
home.experience.support.title: Human support
home.experience.support.copy: Our teams stay available before departure and during travel so help feels close whenever plans change.
home.gallery.modern_bus_alt: Modern long-distance bus ready for departure
home.gallery.city_bus_alt: City transport vehicle near the station
home.gallery.card_copy: From first-time visitors to frequent commuters, the station experience is built to feel organized, reassuring, and elegantly simple.
home.destinations.title: Routes that open the best of Morocco
home.destinations.copy: Explore business hubs, cultural icons, and coastal escapes from one modern departure point.
home.destinations.label: Best-selling route
home.destinations.casablanca: A refined gateway for business days, seaside evenings, and fast connections across the region.
home.destinations.marrakech: Move toward color, design, and unforgettable streets with a smoother long-distance transfer.
home.destinations.chefchaouen: Reach the blue city with more ease through a calmer booking and departure experience.
home.destinations.agadir: Choose a coastal arrival shaped by comfort, cleaner boarding, and more reliable timing.
home.steps.title: Plan, confirm, and depart with clarity
home.steps.copy: The platform keeps the booking flow light, predictable, and ready for real travelers who value time and calm.
home.steps.search.title: Choose your route
home.steps.search.copy: Browse destinations and departure dates in seconds with filters tailored to Morocco's busiest lines.
home.steps.confirm.title: Confirm the details
home.steps.confirm.copy: Review timing, pricing, and seat availability before locking in the trip that fits your schedule.
home.steps.depart.title: Travel with confidence
home.steps.depart.copy: Arrive at a more organized station and board a modern coach with dependable support around you.
home.testimonials.sara.quote: The whole experience felt cleaner and more composed than typical station travel. Booking took minutes and departure was exactly on time.
home.testimonials.youssef.quote: I liked the quiet boarding flow and the visibility of route details. It feels closer to a premium booking platform than a standard bus portal.
home.testimonials.nadia.quote: The interface is elegant, the trip information is clear, and the journey itself felt more comfortable than expected.

home.final_cta.title: Reserve your next departure with a calmer premium experience
home.final_cta.copy: Choose a destination, secure your timing, and travel across Morocco with a platform that feels modern from the first step.
